evidence.summary: An employee submits an expense claim.
Accounts Payable checks receipts and returns incomplete claims to the employee.
The line manager approves business purpose.
Claims above EUR 2,000 additionally require the finance controller.
Accounts Payable pays approved claims and informs the employee.
Rejected claims end with a notice.
For this fictional process, finance-controller approval is now required for EUR 2,500 or more, inclusive. Change only the threshold; preserve all other meaning, identities and unresolved questions.

issues.description: What is the required order or coordination of line-manager and finance-controller approvals, and who evaluates the amount threshold? The snapshot keeps the additional controller rule and payment segment disconnected from manager approval so no approval ordering is asserted. Payment requires all applicable approvals; the controller is additional, never a substitute for the manager.

After Accounts Payable returns an incomplete claim, does the employee correct and resubmit it, and where does it re-enter? The current segment ends at return; this is a scope boundary, not an asserted terminal claim outcome.

Which review decisions can reject a claim, and who issues the rejection notice to whom? The rejected-claim notice is a separate supported segment with unspecified responsibility; no reviewer rejection branch or notification owner is invented.

scenarios.name: Incomplete claim returned
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Accounts Payable returns the claim. Further employee action and re-entry remain unresolved.

scenarios.name: Complete claim receives business-purpose approval
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Line-manager approval is recorded; this does not complete the full reimbursement process.

scenarios.name: EUR 2,500.01 requires additional controller approval
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Controller approval is required in addition to manager approval. Ordering remains unresolved.

scenarios.name: EUR 2,500 requires additional controller approval
scenarios.expectedOutcome: The inclusive threshold requires additional controller approval at exactly EUR 2,500. Manager approval is still required; ordering remains unresolved.

scenarios.name: Approved claim paid and employee informed
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Accounts Payable pays the claim and informs the employee.

scenarios.name: Rejected claim ends with notice
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Rejection ends with notice, with sender, recipient and upstream routing unresolved.

scenarios.name: EUR 2,499.99 does not require controller approval
scenarios.expectedOutcome: Below EUR 2,500, additional controller approval is not required under the revised rule. Manager approval is still required.
